Tests batch bytes extraction API (extract_batch)

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val result = Xberg.extractBatch(listOf(mapper.readValue("{\"bytes\":\"pdf/fake_memo.pdf\",\"filename\":\"fake_memo.pdf\",\"kind\":\"bytes\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)), ExtractionConfig())
    println(result.results.first().mimeType)
    println(result.results.first().content)
}
```
